stories.headline: Tech Titans Slash 140K Jobs as AI Spending Soars
stories.body: American tech companies have cut close to 140,000 jobs this year amid record artificial intelligence spending. stories.headline: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others
stories.body: Moody's said AI spending is forcing even the world's most cash-rich corporations to lean heavily on debt, stock sales and off-balance-sheet moves.
